interaction_summaries: Customer described their market role as helping startup companies grow through business model and framework support. No specific pains mentioned yet. Opportunity to learn more about their service offerings and target customers.

Customer confirmed they are in startup phase and experiencing difficulty with client onboarding. They need a website to onboard clients that collects basic information, job/role in market, pains, and gains (client expectations). This reveals their primary pain point is client onboarding during the startup phase, and their immediate gain requirement is successful client onboarding with complete data collection.

Customer confirmed they have a working automated client onboarding system that captures customer job, pains, and gains. This addresses their pain point of hard time onboarding clients during startup phase. The automation will streamline the manual parts of client onboarding. Their immediate gain is successful client onboarding with complete data collection (job/role, pains, gains) and reduced manual effort.

Customer clarified their primary service offering: web-based solutions, consultation based on pain points, and pain killer suggestions. They serve physical businesses (dental clinics, pet shops, car care) but note industry is not a strict filter. This expands the market role from startup-focused to broader physical business services with B2B solution delivery. The customer's approach combines automated web solutions with human consultation elements.
